services.allowsQuantity: Customer can choose quantity (e.g. 3 items, 25 m²)
services.cannotDeleteInUse: In use by services — remove it from them first, or deactivate it.
services.credentialGateBlocked: Add at least one credential requirement before saving this service at L2 or L3.
services.credentialRequirementsOptional: Level 0 and Level 1 services do not require credentials. L1 is unlocked with validated experience evidence for the classification.
services.credentialRequirementsRequired: Level 2 and Level 3 services must require at least one item — otherwise no provider can ever qualify for them. Commercial General Liability insurance (CGL) is already mandatory for every L2/L3 by level policy; add it here to make it explicit on this service.
services.deleteCategoryConfirm: Delete this category? All services inside will also be removed.
services.deleteRequirementConfirm: Delete requirement {{code}}? This cannot be undone.
services.deleteTaskConfirm: Delete this service? This cannot be undone.
services.emptyCategory: No services in this category yet.
services.experienceHelpHint: Shown in the app when a provider uploads experience evidence for this classification. VISP validates the documents — it does not certify competence.

kindHint.CREDENTIAL: The provider holds it (licence, certificate, training).
kindHint.INSURANCE: A policy on the provider or company account.
kindHint.PERMIT: Belongs to the job, not the provider. Required per booking.

services.manageRequirementsHint: Trade credentials, insurance and job permits that a service can require.
services.mandatoryHint: Unchecked = conditional or alternative (e.g. "306A and/or 309A"). If a service has no required credential, the provider must hold at least one of the conditional ones.
services.noCredsWarning: This L2/L3 service has no credential requirement, so no provider can qualify for it.
services.requirementCodeHint: Uppercase, letters, numbers and underscore. E.g. CGL, 306A, WHMIS.
services.requirementCodeLocked: The code cannot be changed — services already reference it.
services.searchPlaceholder: Search services by name, category, or slug…
services.searchRequirement: Search by code, name or authority…

services.title: Service catalog
services.bookingInputTitle: What the customer must provide when booking
services.bookingInputHelp: The provider sees this before accepting, to judge whether the job is worth taking at their price range. It does not change the scope or the price — those come from the catalogue.
services.requiresDetails: Details are required (the customer must describe the work)
services.requiresEvidence: At least one photo is required
services.detailsPromptPlaceholder: e.g. How many rooms and bathrooms? Any pets? How do we get in?
services.detailsPromptRequired: A service that requires details also needs an English prompt — it is what steers the customer to describe the scale and access of THIS service instead of asking for extra work.
services.requiresInsuranceHelp: The provider must have a verified, in-force policy in their profile before they can offer this service.
services.questionsHelp: The customer answers these when booking and the provider reads them before accepting. Prefer predefined answers when you can: they are comparable across bookings and easier to read at a glance.
services.questionPlaceholder: e.g. Describe the condition of the space
services.optionsTooFew: A question with predefined answers needs at least two distinct options — otherwise the customer cannot answer it and the booking is blocked.
